summary: Use Expo SDK 54, React Native, TypeScript, and Expo Router for the installable mobile app; keep route code under mobile/app.
Use a Zustand store with AsyncStorage persistence; bootstrap from a validated local cache or bundled sample, then refresh from the AR-local daily release payload.
Keep ingest, Pi, dashboard, and payload publication in yanniedog/AR-local; AR-app owns only the installable client and APK release automation.
Node.js 24 is the supported local and Codex Cloud runtime; validate mobile changes with cd mobile && npm run ci.
Response chart points are visual-only, so tapping a plotted lender cannot reveal its bank name.
Added 32px SVG touch targets and provider-selection callback so tapping a response point toggles its lender label; verification pending.
TypeScript validation confirmed the tappable scatter callback and dashboard selection wiring compile cleanly.
Response scatter points now expose a 32px touch target and select/toggle the lender label when tapped.
Response bank cards promote the selected category above the others, preventing Home loans, Savings, and TD from forming equal aligned columns.
Replaced the selected-first stacked bank metrics with fixed SECTION_ORDER columns, equal flex widths, shared heights, and a subtle selected-category highlight.
TypeScript validation confirmed the fixed three-column lender-card layout compiles cleanly.
Every lender card now uses equal, consistently ordered Home loans, Savings, and Term deposits columns.
Installing the post-ingest suitability gate does not notify React/Zustand consumers, leaving the initially rendered section on stale all-product derivations until navigation changes state.
Added a reactive suitability-gate revision and subscribed every mounted surface that caches or directly renders gate-backed product derivations, including Browse, Home, Banks, Trends, and onboarding.
Focused suitability-gate and refresh lifecycle regression tests passed (12 tests), confirming revision notifications and existing refresh behavior.
TypeScript validation passed across all reactive gate subscribers and the new useSyncExternalStore hook.
Post-ingest suitability gate changes now invalidate mounted product derivations and Browse caches immediately, so standard-only filtering no longer waits for a section switch.
Required mobile CI cannot complete in the managed sandbox because Expo Doctor requires outbound Expo API access and the escalation was rejected.
Ran npm run ci; Expo Doctor stopped at 16/18 checks because its config-schema and React Native Directory validations could not reach the Expo API (EACCES), and network escalation was rejected.
Reactive suitability dependencies trigger new exhaustive-deps warnings because the memo bodies do not explicitly read the revision token.
Made each gate-backed memo explicitly consume the revision token so exhaustive-deps recognizes the intentional invalidation dependency.
Lint rerun passed with zero errors and only the repository's 15 pre-existing warnings; all six introduced exhaustive-deps warnings are gone.
Gate-backed memos now explicitly consume the suitability revision without adding lint warnings.

Completed the safer local CI stages individually: typecheck, lint (0 errors), 8 script tests, all 550 Jest tests, and Android/iOS/web export passed; only Expo Doctor's two online checks remain blocked.

Suitability filtering remains an O(1) module-level gate, but gate replacements publish a revision through useSyncExternalStore so mounted memoized product surfaces invalidate immediately after ingest.
Overlapping 32px SVG hit circles can select the wrong dense response point, and 18-character labels can fail to identify the lender uniquely.
Aligned Response lender cards visually show all three section values, but their explicit accessibility label announces only the active section.
Replaced per-point overlapping hit circles with chart-level nearest-point selection that cycles dense candidates, and moved the full selected provider name into an untruncated live callout.
Expanded each lender card's accessibility label to announce Home loans, Savings, and Term deposits values and timing, including no-series states.
Extracted nearest-point/cycling selection into a pure helper and added regression coverage for dense overlapping lenders and full-name disambiguation; targeted tests passed.
Extracted the three-section accessibility label into a pure helper and added regression coverage for all aligned columns and full provider names; targeted tests passed.
Response lender cards now announce Home loans, Savings, and Term deposits values and timing through a tested full accessibility label.
Final typecheck passed after replacing overlapping hit circles with tested chart-level nearest-point cycling and a full provider callout.
Dense response clusters now select the nearest lender and cycle repeated taps, while the selected lender is shown in a full untruncated callout.
APK workflow publishes releases but then fails because README fallback uses GITHUB_TOKEN while Actions PR creation is disabled.
Git staging failed because .git/index.lock could not be created (permission denied).
Retried staging as a single scoped git add after confirming no stale index.lock; staging succeeded.
Scoped single-command staging succeeded and commit 7bc838b was created; no stale lock existed.
Cherry-pick into clean linked worktree could not create the Git sequencer directory because sandboxed Git metadata access was denied.
Retried the scoped cherry-pick with linked-worktree metadata permission; commits a689955 and f24d61f applied cleanly.
The clean release worktree now contains only the two app-fix commits on origin/main.
The release version bump script could not write app.json in the linked C:\tmp worktree (EPERM).
Ran the repository version and changelog scripts with permission to write the linked worktree; v1.0.43 metadata was generated and committed as be169d7.
The clean app-fix branch now includes the explicit v1.0.43 release metadata commit.
PR #26 review found suitability gate change detection relied on mutable Set reference identity, so same-reference content changes could leave subscribers stale.
Content comparison plus Set cloning passed the targeted regression and typecheck, but full Jest exposed two established identity-contract assertions in suitabilityIndex.test.ts.
Preserved the established Set identity contract while comparing against an internal content snapshot; 62 suites / 552 tests, typecheck, and lint (0 errors) passed.
Suitability gate now compares against an internal Set snapshot, preserves its identity contract, and notifies listeners after same-reference mutations; commit 72e6c00 verified by all 552 tests.

PR #26 review found some standard-only consumers still bypass the fail-closed suitability gate or omit the gate revision from memo dependencies (Trends history and shared search/subscription filtering).

Routed filterRows and history fallbacks through the shared suitability gate, subscribed Search/Trends/product-history consumers to gate revisions, and added fail-closed regression coverage; 62 suites / 554 tests, typecheck, and targeted lint passed.
All shared standard-only filtering paths now honor the rebuilt suitability gate, and React consumers rerender on gate revisions; commit 6de65bc adds regression tests.

Recovered the workflow-generated chore/readme-apk-qr-v1.0.43-b156 branch by manually opening PR #27, adding the established mobile README CI marker, clearing review gates, and squash-merging with [skip ci].
README publication recovered through PR #27; main now shows v1.0.43/build 156, and [skip ci] prevented a duplicate APK build.

Version v1.0.43 was included directly in the isolated app-fix PR because the unrelated open PR #25 prevents queue-drain auto-bumping; this avoided merging unrelated work and avoided a later double bump.
APK publishing increments Android versionCode/build_number but can reuse the same expo.version and app-v tag, so separate APK releases are not uniquely iterated in the visible version.

Extended the APK bump step to derive the next visible patch version from the rolling manifest, retained monotonic versionCode logic, and serialized GHA/EAS APK publishers on one concurrency group. Added six unit tests. Targeted and full Jest, typecheck, lint, script tests, and Expo export pass; Expo Doctor remains blocked by sandbox network access.

APK release automation now advances the visible patch version from the rolling manifest, preserves higher intentional version floors, increments Android versionCode, and serializes GHA/EAS publishers. PR #28 exact head passed app-ci.
Use Expo SDK 54, React Native, TypeScript, and Expo Router for the installable mobile app; keep route code under mobile/app.
App updates download only while user is in Settings and stop when backgrounded/screen off; need automatic background APK download then install-from-cache on upgrade prompt

APK updates auto-download via Android DownloadManager (@kesha-antonov/react-native-background-downloader) so transfers continue with screen off / app backgrounded; Upgrade prompt installs the cached APK
Wire background APK download on update check, Upgrade alert/banner/settings install-from-cache, jest mocks + download logic tests
App updates now auto-download in the background via DownloadManager and Upgrade installs the cached APK; verified with typecheck + focused Jest suites
Background APK updates need a native rebuild (EAS/dev client) after adding @kesha-antonov/react-native-background-downloader config plugin; Expo Go cannot run the DownloadManager module
Home tab sync/waiting freezes JS thread so tabs and Settings cannot be opened; sync progress falsely hits 100% on parse json manifest.json; waiting animation appears static
Sync progress bar sits at 100% during parse/inflate of large payloads and after manifest parse while cache re-read continues without progress updates
Home waiting-for-ingest IndeterminateProgressBar/LoadingRows animation appears static during filter prep

Root cause: fetchManifest emits parse@100% for manifest.json then resolveFinalizedManifest/cache work leaves that snapshot visible while JSON.parse of multi-MB payloads freezes the JS thread (tabs/Settings unresponsive); IndeterminateProgressBar uses Reanimated that stalls when JS is blocked
Home sync stays responsive: yield before heavy parse, honest progress phases (finalize/install), native waiting animations; tabs/Settings remain usable during sync
Shipped in PR #42: yieldToUi/parseJsonHeavy, honest progress phases, native waiting animations
Home navigation stays responsive during sync via yields before heavy parse and deferred post-refresh work
Shipped in PR #42: finalize/install phases, phaseComplete soft creep, no false 100% on manifest parse
Sync progress stays accurate through finalize/parse/install with phaseComplete and native soft-motion
